plot: At breakfast Bup and Zeek try to throw Lolly a secret birthday party on the table guarded by crumb-hating Toastmaw; the Anti-Crumb Bubble pops and Pim sneezes crumbs everywhere, but Crispy finds out Toastmaw has never had a party, Lolly reveals she already invited him, and a mystery gift with Mr. Pot's three eyes starts humming.

beats.say: One crumb on my table... and somebody becomes TOAST.
Six in the morning. The humans are still asleep. And today is Lolly's birthday.
Okay team. Operation Sparkle. Lolly wakes up in two hours.
Problem. A cake is basically a crumb factory. And Toastmaw guards this table now.
The toaster who shoots burning toast? Can we party somewhere safer? Like the moon?
He moved here after the oven. He says this is the last clean place in Table Land.
Then we bake a cake with zero crumbs. Zeek, talk to me.
Behold. The Anti-Crumb Bubble. A cake inside a soap bubble. Nothing can escape.
And what happens when the bubble pops?
Statistically? It will never pop.
What was that? Do I smell... CRUMBS?
Hide! Everybody behind the cutting board!
Plan one failed in four seconds. A new record, even for Zeek.
Plan two. We clean up every crumb with this straw. Pim, you suck.
Excuse me? What did you just call me?
Through the straw! You suck through the straw!
Pim sucked. Pim coughed. Then Pim sneezed the crumbs across the entire table.
THAT'S IT! All of you... are TOAST!
Run! Zigzag! He can only shoot in straight lines!
Toastmaw. Stop. Look at what's on the table.
I see a mess. A loud, sticky, sparkly mess.
It's a birthday. For Lolly. Have you ever had one?
Toasters don't get birthdays. We get crumbs. Then somebody shakes us upside down.
Wait. Is he... sad? Is the scary toaster actually sad?
New plan. We don't hide the party from him. We invite him.
That is the worst plan I have ever heard. I love it.
Good morning, everyone! Why is the table covered in glitter?
SURPRISE! Happy birthday, Lolly!
Oh, you sweethearts! And Toastmaw came too? I invited him myself yesterday.
You invited the crumb monster... to a cake party?
Of course. Everyone deserves a party. Even grumpy kitchen machines.
Nobody ever invited me anywhere. I brought warm bread. For the cake.
So we did three crazy plans for nothing?
Not for nothing. For science. And for a very sticky floor.
Speaking of sticky. Who made this mess on my birthday table?
It was Zeek! No, it was me! No, it was the bubble!
Clean. It. Up. NOW!
Ha! Finally. Somebody who understands me.
Then Bup spotted a present nobody had brought. A black box with a red ribbon.
There's no name on it. Just three little eyes drawn on top.
Don't open it. I know that ribbon.
